children: Gold prices declined on Monday, September 7, with the international ounce recording $4,396.3 for buying and $4,395.8 for selling.
The 24-karat price hit EGP 7,226.55 for purchase and EGP 7,152.37 for sale, according to Dahab Masr data at 3:48 PM.
Meanwhile, the 21-karat gold amounted to EGP 6,323.86 for buying and EGP 6,258.95 for selling.
